description: Reviewed workspace snapshots offered as templates. Each is an ordinary workspace aggregate with provenance curated: build one in the studio, promote it with `workspaces export-seed`, review the diff, then restart. A boot at the same seedVersion is a no-op; raise the version to apply a reviewed change.
